svg.text: K3b BELT CASSETTE — the belt is washable ware, the seat does the work
The seat tensions and drives the belt; lifted out, the belt hangs slack and goes into the washer under the seat.
belt 300 wide, 2 mm solid TPU, white · cassette 470 × 350 × 70, 4.5 kg
tension 300 N by 2 spring wedges (12 mm) · drive 3 Nm, 0–0.3 m/s, ±0.5 mm
no seal: canned face coupling, 8 magnets, 4 mm gap
seat on 3 load cells ±2 g · red (raw) and green (all else) cassettes
A IN THE SEAT: set down = tensioned; seat motor drives through the wall
SEAT PLATE = lid of the washer

g.text: tray
nose axle pushed out 12 mm → belt tension 300 N
belt runs: 0–0.3 m/s
reversible (encoder ±0.5 mm)
runs on: the cutlet drops off the nose
lifted out: belt hangs 12 mm slack
seat empty: cassette in the washer (B)
nose Ø 22
tail Ø 50 (driven)
support Ø 40

svg.text: gauge ramp = top edge of the side plate (rises 2 → 24 mm)
B OUT OF THE SEAT: washed in the chamber below

g.text: belt face
(hangs slack)

text.tspan: hand lifts the cassette out, parks it
cassette lowered in, hung by its tang
wash 55 °C, arms on both long walls

svg.text: short programme 12 min · hygiene 28 min, 9 L, 0.7 kWh
C TWO CASSETTES, ONE ROUND TRIP PER USE
back to the cabinet: checked by camera on the way; a reseated cassette runs one turn under the belt camera
RED cassette: raw meat and fish only. GREEN: produce, dough, cooked food, plating.
Each is washed after its use, so the red one never meets ready-to-eat food.

g.text: 1/8 The hand sets the red cassette into the seat: locating cones centre it, the wedges push the nose axle out 12 mm — the belt is taut
2/8 The seat motor turns the tail roller through the closed wall (magnet face coupling): the belt carries the cutlet; the seat weighs it
3/8 The belt reverses and runs on with ±0.5 mm accuracy; the cutlet drops off the nose into a tray
4/8 After its last use the hand lifts the cassette out: the belt goes slack; the hand parks it and lifts the seat plate — the washer lid
5/8 The cassette goes in on edge and hangs by its tang; the lid closes
6/8 Wash: spray arms on both long walls reach both belt faces, rollers, open bushes and side plates
7/8 Hygiene hold: 10 min at 70 °C (short programme inside a meal: 12 min)
8/8 Hot-air dry in the tub; then back to the clean cabinet, stored on edge, never wound or wet
